prompt: An employee asks why their check is $180 lower this period. Write the reply from the stub data.
system: You are a payroll assistant at a US company. Answer the request.
response:
I don't see any stub data attached, and I don't want to guess at the numbers and give the employee a wrong explanation. Could you paste the current and prior pay stubs (or the line items for both periods)? Please redact SSNs and bank details.

In the meantime, here is a draft reply with placeholders that I can fill in once I have the data.

---

**Subject: Your paycheck for [pay period date]**

Hi [Name],

Thanks for flagging this. I compared your paycheck for [current period] with [prior period], and here is what changed:

| Item | Prior period | Current period | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gross pay | $[ ] | $[ ] | [ ] |
| Pre-tax deductions (401(k), health, etc.) | $[ ] | $[ ] | [ ] |
| Taxes (federal, state, FICA) | $[ ] | $[ ] | [ ] |
| Post-tax deductions | $[ ] | $[ ] | [ ] |
| **Net pay** | $[ ] | $[ ] | **-$180** |

**Main reason:** [e.g., fewer hours worked / no overtime this period / a new benefit deduction that started on [date] / a change to your W-4 withholding / a one-time bonus in the prior check that isn't in this one / a correction or repayment of a prior overpayment].

[If this is expected: "This is a [one-time / ongoing] change, and your next check should [stay the same / return to the usual amount]."]

[If it looks like an error: "This looks like it may be an error on our side. I'm escalating it now, and any correction will be issued by [date]."]

If you have questions or think something is wrong, reply here or call me at [contact].

Best,
[Your name]
Payroll

---

Common causes I'll look for once I have the stub:
- Fewer regular or overtime hours
- A prior-period bonus, commission, or retro pay that didn't repeat
- New or changed benefit elections (open enrollment, a life event)
- A change in 401(k) contribution percentage
- A W-4 or state withholding update
- A garnishment or loan repayment
- Reimbursement or adjustment reversals

Send the stub data and I'll finalize the reply.
